name: imgt

scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test

description: Self-hosted image optimization on Cloudflare: Sharp, Workers Cache, and R2.

ALLOWED_HOSTS.description: Comma-separated image source hostnames, e.g. cdn.example.com, *.images.example.com. images.unsplash.com enables the sample image; replace it with your own hosts.

DERIVATIVES.description: Private cache of generated WebP images. Original images are not stored.
